name: George Blankenberg
role: Billings County Republican central committee member
bio: George Blankenberg signed the call for the April 1884 Billings County Republican convention and was elected there to the county central committee, and in October 1884 he and Max Bass, as members of the county central committee, signed a notice protesting that the chairman had called conventions without consulting the committee. That month he was elected a delegate at a Billings County convention held at Belfield, which the Cow Boy questioned.
